comments.text:
Du Pain et des Idées in Paris is indeed priced higher than a typical neighborhood bakery, with many items costing about double standard local rates.

A traditional jambon-beurre is the ultimate everyday, blue-collar French lunch.

The Local Benchmark:
In a standard Parisian boulangerie, a perfectly good, fresh jambon-beurre typically costs between €4.50 and €6.50.

The Caractère de Cochon Premium:  It is good, but too expensive, to pay extra 50% more for a fresh jambon-beurre ???
At Caractère de Cochon, a basic sandwich starts around €10 and can quickly soar to €15, €18, or even €20+ depending on the specific ham and cheese you select. 

The Hype & Wait:
Thanks to immense viral social media hype and its status as a favorite spot of the late Anthony Bourdain, the shop now commands long lines. 

For a resident just wanting a quick bite on a Tuesday lunch break, waiting 20–30 minutes and paying double or triple the standard price for a takeaway sandwich feels entirely unjustifiable.
